$comment: Machine-readable HeaLoa founder rules (Cindy Yang). Human-readable version: HEALOA_RULES.md. Enforced by tests/rules.mjs (plus the other suites named in enforcedBy). Any reviewer tool can read this file: every rule has an id, zh text, en gloss, machine checks (word lists, regex patterns, required UI facts) and the exact test check ids that enforce it.

matchModes.$comment: substring = any occurrence (CJK); word = whole word/phrase, case-insensitive (Latin). es list stays EMPTY until a native reviewer exists.

scope.$comment: customerCodeFiles are scanned with the zh list; each locale file with its own list. repoWideExclude: files that hold the lists themselves.

rules.zh: 健康疗愈，不是治疗：客户界面不出现疾病名和医疗词，用温和的说法（血压偏高 / 睡不踏实 / 怕冷手脚凉 / 肠胃弱 / 心里绷得紧 / 想安静一点；v4 起是配对小测的选项）。
rules.en: Wellness, not treatment: no disease names or medical words on customer screens; use the gentle body-state labels.

rules.zh: 「疗愈 / healing」只能形容地方、氛围、体验、感受，不能说成结果（不说「疗愈失眠」「改善血压」「治焦虑」「有疗效」）。
rules.en: Healing/restorative may describe only a place, atmosphere, experience or feeling, never an outcome (no 'heals insomnia', 'improves blood pressure', 'treats anxiety', 'therapeutic').

allowedNear.zh: (氛围|环境|地方|感受|山林|空气|森林|体验)
allowedNear.ja: (空気|雰囲気|場所|森|景色|体験)

outcomePatterns.re: (疗愈|治愈|调理|改善|缓解|治)(了|好)?(失眠|睡眠|血压|焦虑|肠胃|身体|疾病)
(癒し|癒す|治す)[^。]{0,4}(不眠|血圧|不安|病)

enforcedBy: static-checks:疗愈 / restorative / 癒し only describe a place

rules.zh: 投资人用语不进客户界面：数字资产、AGI、基础设施、网络效应、未来朋友。
rules.en: Investor words never appear in customer UI: digital asset, AGI, infrastructure, network effect, future friend.

rules.zh: 不提中医顾问 / 顾问 / 医学审核人。
rules.en: No mention of a TCM consultant, advisor or medical reviewer.

rules.zh: 身体 / 感受信息永远不进任何分享图、分享链接或网址参数；「留一句」里如果写了身体情况，就不跟着分享链接走。没打开「写出我的情况」时，自己的养护卡和「存成图片」也不写任何能看出情况的字（情况名、和情况有关的安全提醒 / 吃 / 动）。
rules.en: Body/feeling info never goes into a shared card image, share link or URL parameter; a 'leave a line' text naming a condition stays off the share link. With 'write my condition' off, the private card and its saved PNG carry no condition-identifying text either.

privateCardWhenOff.$comment: v2026-09-27-w: with 「写出我的情况」 OFF (the default), the private card (screen) and its 「存成图片」 PNG must contain no condition-identifying text: no condition label (any locale), no privateWords stem, and none of the condition-specific care lines (safety / eat tip / first move). A 留一句 that names a body state stays off too.

enforcedBy: merged-plan:share card + link contain no body-state / feeling words

rules.zh: 存下本季养护卡之后，必须有分享入口，包含「发给一个人」；首页第一屏没有分享；卡片默认「只留给自己」。
rules.en: After saving the season care card there must be a share entry with a 'send to one person' action; no share on the home first screen; the card defaults to 'keep it to myself'.

rules.zh: 不做积分、奖励、拉新返利、连续打卡、邀请换好处。
rules.en: No points, rewards, referrals, check-in streaks or invite-for-benefit.
enforcedBy: merged-plan:no rewards / points / streak / invite wording

rules.zh: App 里永远不链接 healoa.com。
rules.en: The app never links to healoa.com.

rules.zh: 主线顺序（v4，D-27-05）：2 分钟配对（一屏一题）→ 翻牌看这个节气的 3 个地方 → 为什么是你（地点带理由 + 吃 / 做 / 避开）→ 走进一个地方做放松 → 本季养护卡 / 我的养护记录。
rules.en: Main line order (v4): 2-minute match (one question per screen) → flip reveal of 3 places for this solar term → why these places (reasons + eat / do / avoid) → step into one place and relax → season card / my care log.

rules.zh: 照片上不压任何署名；每一页底部（全屏的练习 / 沉浸页在页内）和导出的图片、视频底边都有一行版权声明：「本 App 所有地方照片均由 Cindy Yang 实地拍摄，受版权保护，未经许可请勿转载。」（D-27-06）
rules.en: No credit is overlaid on any photo; one copyright line (All place photos © Cindy Yang …) sits at the bottom of every page (inside the full-screen practice / immersive views) and on the bottom edge of every exported image and video.
rules.copyrightZh: 本 App 所有地方照片均由 Cindy Yang 实地拍摄，受版权保护，未经许可请勿转载。

rules.zh: en / ja 只是草稿，只能用 ?lang= 打开并显示草稿标记；公开的语言切换隐藏；es 为空。
rules.en: en/ja are drafts reachable only via ?lang= with a draft badge; the public language switcher stays hidden; es is empty.

rules.zh: （沿用 v3 锁定 2026-09-26）语气温和、不做情绪日记；不出现旧产品 / 网站用语（光圈、Keeper、Host、Choose Again、/board）。
rules.en: (Carried over from the v3 lock, 2026-09-26) gentle tone, no mood diary; no old product/website terms.

rules.zh: 客户界面不出现内部 / 没做完的用语（网格海拔、待人工核对、样品、照片待补、Climate data……），用长辈看得懂的大白话，或者不显示。数据来源只写在「关于这份 Demo」。
rules.en: No internal / unfinished developer wording on customer screens (grid elevation, to be checked by hand, sample, photo coming, 'Climate data' …); say it plainly or hide it. Data sources live only in the About section.

rules.zh: 放松练习对每个人都安全：不管小测里选了什么（v4 可以多选，也可以跳过），任何练习都不能靠「选了什么」来保护人。任何一步都不憋气超过 2 秒（不做 4-7-8 这类长憋气），用吸 4 呼 6 这类温和的长呼气。
rules.en: Every practice is safe for everyone: whatever was picked in the quiz (multi-select, skippable), no practice may rely on it. No breath hold longer than 2 seconds anywhere (no 4-7-8); use gentle extended-exhale patterns such as in 4 / out 6.
rules.holdDefinition: a breath phase whose circle scale equals the previous phase's scale (cyclic), or a step text that says to pause / hold for N seconds

rules.zh: 所有地方从第一次打开就全部开放：有一个「所有地方」列表，列出每个有实拍照片的地方，都能点进去；没有锁、没有「即将开放」、不用先完成什么才能看（v4，D-27-05）。
rules.en: Every place is open from the first visit: an all-places list shows every place with a real photo and each one opens; no locks, no 'coming soon', nothing to complete first.

rules.zh: 知识库的中医权重层在 Cindy 的资料到之前不生效：每个权重都是 null（按 0 算）；没有来源（sourceRef 指向已核对的资料）的吃 / 做 / 避开 / 适合谁句子一律不显示（v4，D-27-05）。
rules.en: The knowledge-base (TCM) layer is off until Cindy's materials arrive: every weight is null (counted as 0); an eat / do / avoid / suits sentence without a verified source is never displayed.

rules.zh: 配对小测：一屏一题，共 8 题；方案里写「可以选几个」的题（Q1 / Q5 / Q6 / Q7）可以多选，其余单选；每题都有「都不是 / 说不准」、能回上一题、有进度条；答案只存在手机本机，不进网址、分享链接、分享图（v4，D-27-05）。
rules.en: Matching quiz: one question per screen, 8 questions; multi-select where the plan says (Q1/Q5/Q6/Q7), single choice elsewhere; every question has skip, back and a progress bar; answers stay on the phone, never in the URL, share link or share image.

rules.zh: 分享的每个按钮都真的能用：系统分享 / 存图片 / 存视频 / 复制链接 / 短信（en）/ LINE、X（ja）；不放只会「存图再叫你自己打开 App」的平台按钮；导出是 9:16（1080×1920）照片铺满的图；二维码只在 zh（D-27-06）。
rules.en: Every share button genuinely works (system share, save image, save video, copy, sms / LINE / X); no fake platform buttons; exports are full-bleed 9:16 1080×1920; QR code only in zh.

rules.zh: 提醒和音乐都是自己打开才有、默认关；提醒语气轻、错过不提示、没有连续天数；音乐只用手机当场合成的音色或 Cindy 提供的有版权的曲子（D-27-06）。
rules.en: Reminders and music are opt-in and off by default; reminders are gentle, no streaks, nothing for a missed day; music is synthesised on the device or a licensed track supplied by Cindy.
